mimo-v2.5.source: Xiaomi MiMo Responses API reference (mimo.mi.com/docs/en-US/api/chat/responses): reasoning.effort lists none/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max/ultra, minimal mapped to low and xhigh/max/ultra mapped to high, so low/medium/high are accepted rungs. The chat-completions and anthropic pages document only thinking.enabled|disabled, which is why this ladder had been dropped in 0.1.82 — the Responses page was missed.
